real_qa.r: Beyond financial benefits, Profit First helps law firm owners work fewer hours, get more control of their time, have less stress and anxiety, and feel more confident. real_qa.q: At what profit-taking percentage can law firm owners safely start implementing Profit First without affecting operations?
